findingDetails.title: Three hand-synced scope copies claim to mirror one another and diverge on two classes; no parity gate binds them
findingDetails.claim: The engine inScope(), the packager _is_versioned_doc() and the router isVersionedSkillDoc() are three hand-written copies of one scope policy; root-level changelog and SKILL.md under tests/fixtures already resolve differently, and no shared source, import or parity test binds them despite 'Mirrors frontmatter-version.mjs inScope()' comments.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched for a shared constant or import (engine exports nothing and runs main() at import, frontmatter-version.mjs:587), a parity test (none references two implementations together), and a live violating entry (no tests/fixtures SKILL.md exists; all scanned changelog entries carry 4-part versions).
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: Both divergences may be deliberate: the packager validates changelog release versions and delegates SKILL.md to validate_frontmatter (package_skill.py:127-128). Under that reading the defect is the inaccurate mirror comments plus missing parity coverage; same severity and fix.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A single-source scope table or a class-matrix parity test that encodes the two intentional exceptions, or mirror comments corrected to name them.
